senses.gloss: to give oranges to eat. Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ bot. הַתְרִיגוּ וכ׳ (ed. Krot. התריגי), v. בַּהָם.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b:13">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (in enigmatic speech) <he>הַתְרִיגוּ לפחמין</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>אַתְרִיגוּ</he> Chaldaism) make the coals bright, v. <cite ref="G00080"><he>זָהָב</he></cite>.
